req.title: Delete only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to delete a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to delete it, and any other user should receive a 403 Forbidden response. This ensures proper authorization control over post deletion. The test suite includes a positive case where the author deletes their own post, a negative case where a non-author attempts to delete a post, and a boundary case where the post does not exist.

tests.name: test_author_can_delete_own_post
preconditions: User is logged in as the author
A post exists authored by the user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login as author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'Content'})

# Get post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = int(r.data.split(b'id=')[1].split(b'"')[0])

# Attempt to delete the post
r = client.post(f'/{post_id}/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302

tests.name: test_non_author_cannot_delete_post
preconditions: User is logged in as a non-author
A post exists authored by another user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login as author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'Content'})

# Get post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = int(r.data.split(b'id=')[1].split(b'"')[0])

# Logout author
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Register and login as non-author
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'non_author', 'password': 'pass'})

# Attempt to delete the post
r = client.post(f'/{post_id}/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_post
actions: Attempt to delete a non-existent post
expected: HTTP 404 response indicating post not found
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login as user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})

# Attempt to delete a non-existent post
non_existent_post_id = 9999
r = client.post(f'/{non_existent_post_id}/delete')
assert r.status_code == 404
